title: Towards Realistic Scene Generation with LiDAR Diffusion Models

output_modality.value: lidar: single-frame LiDAR range images (32 x 1024 or 64 x 1024) converted to point clouds.

control_signal.value: Semantic maps (image-based), bounding boxes and keypoints (token-based), multi-camera views, and text prompts.

control_mechanism.value: Image-based conditions handled as image-to-image translation; token-based conditions by cross-attention; camera views by concatenated CLIP global features; text through CLIP embeddings.

base_model.value: Latent diffusion on range images with an autoencoder using curve-wise compression, point-wise coordinate supervision and patch-wise encoding, with VQ regularisation and a CurveGAN discriminator.

datasets.value: nuScenes 32-beam and KITTI-360 64-beam; SemanticKITTI for the semantic-map-to-LiDAR task.

metrics.value: Perceptual FRID, FSVD and FPVD; statistical JSD and MMD; throughput and inference speed.

controllability_evidence.value: Conditional quality is claimed but no conditional numbers are in the packet; shown unconditional FPVD 29.0 versus 33.4 for LiDARGen, with x107 throughput.

closed_loop.value: No; single-scene generation, no rollout with a driving policy.

stated_limitations.value: Generated samples still show a visual gap to real LiDAR; autoencoder may give blurry object-background boundaries, producing unreasonable 3D objects.

notes: Main benchmark is unconditional generation; control is a secondary capability, with conditional results beyond the packet.
